statements.statement: The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient reports recurrent episodes of palpitations accompanied by intermittent dizziness and giddiness
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular disease
The diagnosis code for palpitations (R00.2) was submitted
The diagnosis code for dizziness and giddiness (R42) was submitted
The diagnosis code for mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0) was submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
